static_traits.name: 张德瑞
static_traits.family_status: Living alone，与父母和兄弟姐妹关系密切
static_traits.social_status: 与同事关系因Self-doubt与比较而变得紧张
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；既往without类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, can describe emotions and events, relatively high cooperativeness, calm tone

basic_info.main_problem: I feel like a failure because no one bought my artwork when I tried to pursue a career as an artist. This has led to feelings of inadequacy and self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到这种not足感和Self-doubt已经影响了我的整体幸福与快乐，这促使我在此时寻求咨询。
growth_experiences: 约三年前，张德瑞尝试将艺术作为Career development方向，投入大量时间与精力创作，但作品without人购买；这一挫折引发了强烈的压力与失落，此后持续出现“I am not good enough、I am a failure”的自我评价。他开始频繁将当前的工作与经济状况与“成功的Artist”形象进行比较，感到需要not断证明自己、赚更多钱，进而形成持续的自卑与Self-doubt。

special_situations.event: 尝试做Artist时期，艺术作品without人购买
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果作品卖not出去，就证明I am not good enough/是个失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Distracting attention with work and hobbies, striving to prove one's own value through work and a higher income
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这证明I am a failure，艺术之路no hope

special_situations.event: 看到成功的Artist，或想到再次从事艺术
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我达not到他们的水平，就说明我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避再次尝试艺术，更多投入当前工作以减少被再次negate的可能
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远not可能像他们那样成功，我会再次失败

special_situations.event: 生日聚会中有一位兄弟姐妹not yet出席
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果家人not来，就说明他们not在乎我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly recalls the event and avoids communicating with that sibling to avoid deeper hurt
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们not重视我，这场聚会是失败的

special_situations.event: 将当前工作与收入与“成功Artist”的理想形象进行比较
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我赚得not多、not是成功的Artist，我就not值得、have not价值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断督促自己多赚钱、加大比较以寻求他人认可
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough，我必须通过赚钱与成绩来证明自己

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and affirmed (to be seen and valued in artistic pursuits and intimate relationships)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate、Being rejected、被贴上“失败者”的标签
defense_goal: 通过回避直接冲突与避免再次尝试来降低Being rejected的风险
Maintains a sense of self-worth through work and earning money
用Rationalization来弱化受伤感受（告诉自己对方可能有原因、自己“太敏感”）

object_relations.self_representation: 被忽视、受伤的组织者/当事人
object_relations.object_representation: 冷漠、not重视我的亲人（缺席者）
成功且带有评判性的他人/Artist

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about or facing a sibling's absence and considering communicating with them
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将对方的缺席理解为“not在乎我/not重视我”，自我定位为Being rejected者
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 回避直接表达受伤，use缓冲语句（如“他们可能有原因”“是我太敏感了”），语气收敛，减少对抗。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 看到成功Artist或想到再次从事艺术时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为他人会看not起自己，若再尝试必定失败（把自身not安全感归于他人评价）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use假设性与推测性表述（“他们not会认可我”），降低自我暴露，Displacement到当前工作的叙述。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在工作中反复回想失败经历或聚会缺席事件后Low mood
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将负面后果全部归为自身not足，Reinforcement“I am a failure”的自我指向
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自我贬损与自责语句（如“都是I am not good enough”），语气低落，减少对外部情境因素的提及。

manifestations: 艺术职业尝试受挫后，持续将自我价值与是否卖出作品、收入和“成功Artist”的形象绑定
在当前工作与理想艺术身份之间反复比较，感觉需要not断证明自己
outcomes: 睡眠受到影响、Decline in work performance
整体幸福感与Decreased enjoyment of life

manifestations: 生日聚会兄弟姐妹not yet到场被体验为被忽视与拒绝
倾向将一次缺席理解为关系not被重视
outcomes: Tense relationships with colleagues，社交受损

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Categorizing one's own feelings as 'too sensitive', appearing hesitant and restrained about expressing hurt and putting forward needs
Strict with myself in relationships, worried about disturbing others or causing conflict

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 将兄弟姐妹的缺席理解为“have not优先考虑我/not重视我”
在看到成功者时假设他人会negate自己

positive_force: Close relationships with family, able to talk about personal problems to a certain extent
Has a stable job and basic occupational functioning
Has invested a lot of time and energy in artistic pursuits, showing persistence and investment ability
Social support exists (friends and family attend the party and bring thoughtful gifts)
negative_force: Cognitive distortions such as overgeneralization, all-or-nothing thinking, personalization, and comparison are prominent
Self-worth excessively dependent on external evaluation and money indicators
反刍与回避沟通维持了负性循环
Self-doubt导致Sleep disturbance、Decline in work performance与Interpersonal tension

target_behavior.behavior: 反刍与Self-denial（将单次挫折或事件贴上“全面失败”的标签）
antecedent: 回想生日聚会中兄弟姐妹缺席
工作中走神并回放失败经历
回忆三年前艺术not yet售出的经历
target_behavior.core_reason: 受“I am a failure/I am not good enough”的核心信念与外部认可取向驱动，以避免再次被negate与Being rejected的恐惧
target_behavior.function: 短期逃避失败与Being rejected的痛苦、降低面对冲突与not确定性的Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance、Tense relationships with colleagues、Sleep affected、Decreased enjoyment of life，维持并加重自卑与Self-doubt
